author: Startup Orillia
title: Get More From Your Chamber Membership
summary: Turn your Chamber membership into a practical 90-day plan for relationships, visibility, learning, and business opportunities.
exampleQuestions: How can I get more from my Chamber membership?
Which events should I consider and who should I try to meet?
Build a 90-day plan that fits a few hours each month.
expectedOutput: Up to three goals, relevant events and businesses to explore, one useful community contribution, event preparation and follow-up, a monthly time budget, a simple 90-day review, and three next actions.
